steps: Hold Mercy of Heaven until your frontline is at a crucial moment
Apply the 10% defense buff to help them hold position and withstand enemy attacks

techniques.name: Cavalry stun timing
techniques.rhythm: Stun cavalry mid-charge (rather than after) to prevent the charge from landing at all.

Force them to burn their CC immunity
Let teammates follow up with stuns to neutralize them

gameplay.text: Primary role — support your team: provide buffs and healing, especially via the rune Mercy of Heaven, which boosts allies' defenses by 10%. Apply this buff to your frontline at crucial moments to help them hold position and withstand enemy attacks; proper timing and positioning are key to maximizing the buff's effect.

Secondary role — disrupt the enemy: against melee-heavy teams, use stuns and crowd control to break enemy formations and create openings for your team. Against cavalry-reliant enemies, intercept and disrupt their charges — stun cavalry mid-charge to prevent them wreaking havoc. Against Xuanjia heavy cavalry specifically: engage early to force them to burn their CC immunity, letting your teammates follow up with stuns to neutralize them.
In summary, balance between buffing your team and disrupting the enemy is essential for effective Longsword play.
